dialogue.speaker: Static Voice
dialogue.text: You're already dead, friend. The Butcher and the Strategist buried you—yet the pact drags you back.

dialogue.speaker: The Strategist
dialogue.text: You think dying was an accident? Look at the rift...

dialogue.speaker: The Betrayer
dialogue.text: I sealed the pact so neither of us could leave. I did pull the trigger. I will tell you why, but not before you see what the contract hid.

dialogue.speaker: Thought
dialogue.text: The voice blames the gangsters. The ledger says a close-range shot—and the shell casing is from your friend's pistol.

dialogue.speaker: The Butcher
dialogue.text: I left the back door open. Your friend asked for a way out before the ritual started.

dialogue.speaker: The Strategist
dialogue.text: I changed one word. The original says at least one. The rest of the contract? I never wrote it.

dialogue.speaker: The Pact
dialogue.text: AT LEAST ONE. Not exactly one. Your return was allowed. The tether was not an accident.

dialogue.speaker: Your Friend
dialogue.text: The Strategist planned to bind your living soul as the Witness's anchor. I shot you to interrupt it. I tried to save you first. I am still responsible for killing you.
